newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan govt says hopes tie-up helps NCB restructure.
newsitem.headline: Japan govt says hopes tie-up helps NCB restructure.

text.p: The Japanese government hopes the planned tie-up between Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) and Bankers Trust New York Corp will help NCB restructure itself, Chief Cabinet Secretary Seiroku Kajiyama told reporters on Thursday.

"The agreement reached between Nippon Credit Bank and Bankers Trust will make up for Nippon Credit Bank's withdrawal from foreign operations and we hope the agreement will contribute to Nippon Credit's restructuring," Kajiyama said.
